about: Per-stock build recipe for tools/film_profiles/build.py. Source: Agfa Technical Data PF, 1st edition 09/1998 (agfa_films.pdf, 125px.com mirror). Characteristic curves: daylight 1/100 s, Process AP 70 / C-41, status M; sensitivity: equal-energy spectrum, reading density 1.0 above minimum density; RMS granularity measured at diffuse density 1.0, 48 um aperture.

agfa_portrait_xps_160.name: Agfa Portrait XPS 160
agfa_portrait_xps_160.datasheet_heading: AGFACOLOR PORTRAIT XPS 160 PROFESSIONAL (ISO 160/23°, daylight, AP 70/C-41, RMS 3.5)
agfa_portrait_xps_160.still_precedent: the shipped still portrait negatives (Kodak Portra 160, Fujifilm Pro 160S)
notes: Negs has no Agfacolor RA-4 print paper; refined against kodak_portra_endura as the portrait RA-4 reference paper.

The characteristic y-axis fits the 7 interior gridlines (0.5..3.5 D) and top frame edge (4.0 D); the bottom box border sits ~1.03 pt below the uniform 0.0 D gridline spacing (the '0' text label aligns with the gridline spacing, not the box edge).
agfa_portrait_xps_160.check6_fallback: the §D3 fallback (a flat extension past 700 nm) was not tried, as the worst point is not near 700 nm
